name: M3_MMS100MI_LstLines
description: List detailed information for one or more lines on a requisition or distribution order. Uses the order number as main key and can return multiple lines in one call. Includes line identification, item and description, line status, quantities, warehouse and location, lot and container data, dates, references, and responsible user. Danger and hazardous-goods status is not part of line data; that is held as the danger indicator on the order head.

inputParameters.name: TRNR
inputParameters.description: Requisition or distribution order number for which lines are listed.

inputParameters.name: PONR
inputParameters.description: Optional line number used to restrict the listing to a specific order line.

inputParameters.name: POSX
inputParameters.description: Optional line suffix used to restrict the listing to a specific sub-line under the main line number.

outputParameters.name: PONR
outputParameters.description: Line number of the requisition or distribution order line.

outputParameters.name: POSX
outputParameters.description: Suffix identifying a sub-line under the main line number.

outputParameters.name: ITNO
outputParameters.description: Item number for the product on this order line.

outputParameters.name: ITDS
outputParameters.description: Item name or description for the product on this line.

outputParameters.name: TRSH
outputParameters.description: Highest status reached for this requisition or distribution order line.

outputParameters.name: WHLO
outputParameters.description: Warehouse for this requisition or distribution order line.

outputParameters.name: RTRD
outputParameters.description: Requested date for performing the transaction on this order line.

outputParameters.name: TRDT
outputParameters.description: Transaction date for this order line, typically the planned issue date at the sending warehouse.

outputParameters.name: CTRD
outputParameters.description: Current transaction date registered for this order line.

outputParameters.name: RPDT
outputParameters.description: Date when the latest reporting transaction for this order line was performed.

outputParameters.name: AMDT
outputParameters.description: Shipment date associated with this distribution order line.

outputParameters.name: RCDT
outputParameters.description: Date when the most recent goods receipt was reported for this line.

outputParameters.name: WHSL
outputParameters.description: Stock location in the warehouse from which the goods on this line are issued.

outputParameters.name: BANO
outputParameters.description: Lot number identifying the specific batch for this line.

outputParameters.name: CAMU
outputParameters.description: Container identifier on which the goods for this line are handled.

outputParameters.name: HLDR
outputParameters.description: Holder of the stock for this line, such as a supplier, customer, or warehouse.

outputParameters.name: REPN
outputParameters.description: Receiving number automatically assigned when goods were received for this line.

outputParameters.name: STAS
outputParameters.description: Status of the balance identity used for this line, for example under inspection, approved, or rejected.

outputParameters.name: BREF
outputParameters.description: First additional lot reference associated with the lot on this line.

outputParameters.name: BRE2
outputParameters.description: Second additional lot reference associated with the lot on this line.

outputParameters.name: BREM
outputParameters.description: Free-text remark for this distribution order line or its balance identity.

outputParameters.name: TWSL
outputParameters.description: Destination location in the receiving warehouse for this line.

outputParameters.name: TRQT
outputParameters.description: Transaction quantity in the basic unit of measure for this line.

outputParameters.name: ALQT
outputParameters.description: Quantity in basic unit of measure that is allocated for this line.

outputParameters.name: DPQT
outputParameters.description: Quantity that has been dispatched from inventory for this order line.

outputParameters.name: QTRL
outputParameters.description: Quantity confirmed as issued and relocated for this distribution order line.

outputParameters.name: QTIT
outputParameters.description: Quantity for this line that is currently in transit between warehouses.

outputParameters.name: RPQT
outputParameters.description: Accumulated reported quantity for this order line.

outputParameters.name: OEND
outputParameters.description: Indicator that delivery for this order line is completed and remaining quantity will not be backordered.

outputParameters.name: ALUN
outputParameters.description: Alternate unit of measure in which the transaction quantity for this line can be expressed.

outputParameters.name: POCY
outputParameters.description: Normal potency or concentration used for inventory accounting and planning of the item on this line.

outputParameters.name: NUPR
outputParameters.description: Number of partial reporting transactions that have been performed for this order line.

outputParameters.name: NUPI
outputParameters.description: Number identifying the picking list index associated with this order line.

outputParameters.name: OVGT
outputParameters.description: Order type used when issuing repairable items related to this line.

outputParameters.name: JDCD
outputParameters.description: Code indicating which order lines are to be delivered together in a joint delivery.

outputParameters.name: STCD
outputParameters.description: Code indicating how the stock for this item is handled in inventory accounting.

outputParameters.name: NOAA
outputParameters.description: Overriding allocation method controlling how this order line is allocated regardless of item defaults.

outputParameters.name: TRPR
outputParameters.description: Inventory accounting price applied to this transaction line.

outputParameters.name: PRDT
outputParameters.description: Priority date used when selecting balance identities for this line, for example in FIFO calculations.

outputParameters.name: RORC
outputParameters.description: Category indicating the type of reference order from which this line originates.

outputParameters.name: RORN
outputParameters.description: Number of the reference order linked to this requisition or distribution order line.

outputParameters.name: RORL
outputParameters.description: Line number on the reference order associated with this distribution order line.

outputParameters.name: RESP
outputParameters.description: User ID of the person responsible for this order or line.

outputParameters.name: DEPT
outputParameters.description: Department responsible for this order line, often used as a cost center.

outputParameters.name: AVDT
outputParameters.description: Date when the item on this line is planned to be available (available-to-promise date).

outputParameters.name: PROJ
outputParameters.description: Project number to which this distribution order line is linked.

outputParameters.name: ELNO
outputParameters.description: Project element within the linked project that this distribution order line relates to.

outputParameters.name: RSCD
outputParameters.description: Reason code explaining why this distribution order line was created or changed.

outputParameters.name: TRQA
outputParameters.description: Transaction quantity for this line expressed in an alternate unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: ALQA
outputParameters.description: Allocated quantity for this line expressed in an alternate unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: DPQA
outputParameters.description: Dispatched quantity for this line expressed in an alternate unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: RPQA
outputParameters.description: Reported quantity for this line expressed in an alternate unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: TXID
outputParameters.description: Identifier of the text or comments associated with this order line.

outputParameters.name: CFIN
outputParameters.description: Configuration number identifying the specific product configuration for this line.

outputParameters.name: HAZI
outputParameters.description: Danger indicator
